targets.name: correctness
targets.wanted: every case prints the answer the generator computed, on every compiler, at every level

targets.name: code-quality:rucc
targets.wanted: the code rucc produces at -O2 is within ten percent of what gcc-16 produces at -O2

targets.name: compile-throughput:rucc
targets.wanted: rucc compiles the corpus at least as fast as gcc-16 does, which is the corpus proxy for the throughput target in spec 00

rewriting an operation into a cheaper one with the same value
algebraic identities and the local peephole rules
reassociating a chain to shorten its dependency height
removing a computation whose result nothing reads
removing a store a later store makes invisible
removing a branch with a known condition and its dead arm
reusing an earlier computation instead of repeating it
replacing a load with the value already in that place
moving a computation to where it runs no more often
propagating a copy so the copy becomes dead
propagating a value constant on every reaching path
narrowing an integer to the range it can hold
proving two references cannot name the same object
turning a non-escaping local back into a value
hoisting an invariant computation out of a loop
rewriting induction variables into a cheaper set
removing a test the loop guard already decided
unrolling a loop body, known trip count or not
recognizing a loop the runtime already implements
deleting a loop whose body nobody reads
rotating a loop so the test lands at the bottom
exchanging or fusing loops for locality
replacing a call with the body of what it called
turning a call in tail position into a jump
proving purity and using it at the call sites
specializing a function to a constant argument
removing what nothing references
turning an indirect call into a direct one
choosing the machine instruction for an operation
assigning registers and deciding what to spill
ordering instructions within a block
laying out blocks so the common path falls through
turning a short branch into branchless code
choosing how to lower a switch
deciding what a call saves and restores
the rules that only make sense on machine instructions
programs where the compiler must not act, and a firing is a bug
language shape rather than optimization, including C23
